name: Green Industrial
summary: Light grey sheds, green walls at the office, rooftop solar and dense tree rows.

design_language.style: climate-responsive green industrial campus suitable for Vietnam
design_language.secondary_material: dark grey steel frames with planted green facade screens
design_language.office_material: solar-controlled glazing behind vertical green walls
design_language.accent: living green walls at the office and entrance bays

environment.weather: bright tropical late morning with scattered cumulus

presentation.landscape_character: dense rows of tropical shade trees (sao đen, dầu, bàng) along roads and boundaries; planted buffers and bioswales
presentation.paving_character: dark asphalt on every external and perimeter road; light-grey industrial concrete with joints, drainage and light dust on internal yards and loading aprons

brief.roof_type: symmetric low-slope gable profiled-metal roof fitted inside LOD100 envelope
